_meta.source: manufacturer manuals listed per brand (PDF or manufacturer support page), all fetched 2026-10-13/14
_meta.notes: Inverex Nitrox on-grid (12-25 kW) added 2026-10-15 from Inverex's own manual as hosted on ManualsLib. Still skipped: Inverex Veyron/Aerox hybrids (the 'APT Veyron' manuals on ManualsLib do not name Inverex, so they cannot be attributed); Knox - no official site or manual found (retailer w11stop lists datasheets only). Growatt MOD/MID and Growatt SPH hybrids not read (MIN TL-X and SPF ES Plus only). GoodWe F41-F163 not extracted. Huawei alarm IDs come from the L1 (2-6 kW single-phase) manual Issue 10; newer issues exist. Fronius Symo/Primo Class 1-5 STATE codes were read from the Symo Hybrid online manual and GEN24 codes from the GEN24 PDF. 'causes' and 'action' fields quote the manual where quoted; sentences starting 'Owner:' are plain-English guidance derived from the quoted manual text, not additional manufacturer statements. call_installer=true where the manual says to contact dealer/service/repair center or the fix needs DC/AC wiring work.
_meta.installer_flags: call_installer set to true on 2026-10-14 (engineer review) wherever the manual's remedy needs wiring, terminal, protection-setting or part replacement work.

brands.name: Growatt SPF (off-grid / hybrid 'ES' series)

codes.causes: Manual: 'Fan fault.'
codes.action: Manual: '1.Check whether all fans are working properly. 2.Replace the fan.' Owner: check the fan is not blocked by dust; replacement is an installer job.
codes.source_ref: Growatt SPF 6000 ES PLUS User Manual v1.0, Trouble Shooting table (pp. 41-42)

codes.causes: Manual: 'Internal temperature of component is over 100C.'
codes.action: Manual: '1. Check whether the air flow of the unit is blocked or whether the ambient temperature is too high. 2. Check whether the thermistor plug is loose.' Owner: clear vents, improve ventilation; if it repeats call installer.
codes.source_ref: Growatt SPF 6000 ES PLUS User Manual v1.0, Trouble Shooting table (pp. 41-42)

codes.meaning: Battery voltage is too high (battery over-charged)
codes.causes: Manual: 'Battery is over-charged.' / 'The battery voltage is too high.'
codes.action: Manual: 'Restart the unit, if the error happens again, please return to repair center.' and 'Check if spec and quantity of batteries are meet requirements.'
codes.source_ref: Growatt SPF 6000 ES PLUS User Manual v1.0, Trouble Shooting table (pp. 41-42)

codes.meaning: Battery voltage / SOC is too low (low battery)
codes.causes: Manual: 'The battery voltage/SOC is too low.'
codes.action: Manual: '1. Measure battery voltage in DC input. 2. Check battery SOC in LCD when use Li battery 3. Recharge the battery.'
codes.source_ref: Growatt SPF 6000 ES PLUS User Manual v1.0, Trouble Shooting table (pp. 41-42)

codes.causes: Manual: 'Output short circuited.'
codes.action: Manual: 'Check if wiring is connected well and remove abnormal load.' Owner: switch off loads, look for a faulty appliance; if the fault stays, call installer.
codes.source_ref: Growatt SPF 6000 ES PLUS User Manual v1.0, Trouble Shooting table (pp. 41-42)

codes.meaning: Output voltage abnormal (too high / too low)
codes.causes: Manual: 'Output abnormal (Inverter voltage is higher than 280Vac or lower than 80Vac).'
codes.action: Manual: '1. Reduce the connected load. 2. Restart the unit, if the error happens again, please return to repair center.'
codes.source_ref: Growatt SPF 6000 ES PLUS User Manual v1.0, Trouble Shooting table (pp. 41-42)

codes.causes: Manual: 'The inverter is overload 110% and time is up.'
codes.action: Manual: 'Reduce the connected load by switching off some equipment.'
codes.source_ref: Growatt SPF 6000 ES PLUS User Manual v1.0, Trouble Shooting table (pp. 41-42)

codes.causes: Manual: '1. If you connect to a lithum battery without communication, check whether the voltage points of the program 19 and 21 are too high for the lithum battery.'
codes.action: Manual: '2. Restart the unit, if the error happens again, please return to repair center.'
codes.source_ref: Growatt SPF 6000 ES PLUS User Manual v1.0, Trouble Shooting table (pp. 41-42)

codes.meaning: Bus soft start failed / inverter soft start failed / current sensor failed
codes.causes: Manual: 'Internal components failed.'
codes.action: Manual: 'Restart the unit, if the error happens again, please return to repair center.'
codes.source_ref: Growatt SPF 6000 ES PLUS User Manual v1.0, Trouble Shooting table (pp. 41-42)

codes.causes: Manual: 'The input status is different in parallel system.'
codes.action: Manual: 'Check if AC input wires of all inverters are connected well.' (parallel systems only; installer task)
codes.source_ref: Growatt SPF 6000 ES PLUS User Manual v1.0, Trouble Shooting table (pp. 41-42)

codes.causes: Manual: 'Input phase is not correct.'
codes.action: Manual: 'Change the input phase S and T wiring.' (installer task)
codes.source_ref: Growatt SPF 6000 ES PLUS User Manual v1.0, Trouble Shooting table (pp. 41-42)

codes.causes: Manual: 'The output phase not correct in parallel.'
codes.action: Manual: '1.Make sure the parallel setting are the same system(sigle or paralle; 3P1,3P2,3P3). 2.Make sure all phases inverters are power on.'
codes.source_ref: Growatt SPF 6000 ES PLUS User Manual v1.0, Trouble Shooting table (pp. 41-42)

codes.causes: Manual: 'Li battery can't communicate to the inverter.'
codes.action: Manual: '1. Check whether communication line is correct connection between inverter and battery. 2. Check whether BMS protocol type is correct setting.'
codes.source_ref: Growatt SPF 6000 ES PLUS User Manual v1.0, Trouble Shooting table (pp. 41-42)

codes.causes: Manual: 'Over current or surge.'
codes.action: Manual: 'Restart the unit, if the error happens again, please return to repair center.'
codes.source_ref: Growatt SPF 6000 ES PLUS User Manual v1.0, Trouble Shooting table (pp. 41-42)

codes.causes: Manual: 'Bus voltage is too low.'
codes.action: Manual: 'Restart the unit, if the error happens again, please return to repair center.'
codes.source_ref: Growatt SPF 6000 ES PLUS User Manual v1.0, Trouble Shooting table (pp. 41-42)

codes.meaning: Output voltage is unbalanced / over DC voltage in AC output
codes.causes: Manual (fault table): 'Over DC voltage in AC output'; (troubleshooting): 'Output voltage is unbalanced'
codes.action: Manual: 'Restart the unit, if the error happens again, please return to repair center.'
codes.source_ref: Growatt SPF 6000 ES PLUS User Manual v1.0, Trouble Shooting table (pp. 41-42)

codes.causes: Manual: 'Battery is not connected well or fuse is burnt.' and, for lithium without communication, 'check whether the voltage points of the program 19 and 21 are too high for the lithum battery.'
codes.action: Manual: '2. If the battery is connected well, restart the unit. If the error happens again, please return to repair center.'
codes.source_ref: Growatt SPF 6000 ES PLUS User Manual v1.0, Trouble Shooting table (pp. 41-42)

codes.causes: Manual: '1. Check whether the AC output connected to the grid input. 2. Check whether Program 8 settings are the same for all parallel inverters 3. Check whether the current sharing cables are connected well in the same parallel phases. 4. Check whether all neutral wires of all parallel units are connected together.'
codes.action: Manual: '5. If problem still exists, contact repair center.' (wiring checks are installer work)
codes.source_ref: Growatt SPF 6000 ES PLUS User Manual v1.0, Trouble Shooting table (pp. 41-42)

codes.causes: Fault table entry only: 'PV voltage is too high'. (Manual gives no cause text for this code.)
codes.action: Not detailed in troubleshooting table. Installer must check PV string voltage against inverter limit.
codes.source_ref: Growatt SPF 6000 ES PLUS User Manual v1.0, Fault Reference Code table (p. 35)

codes.causes: Fault table entry only: 'Internal communication error'.
codes.action: Not detailed in troubleshooting table; treat like other internal faults (restart; if it repeats, repair center).
codes.source_ref: Growatt SPF 6000 ES PLUS User Manual v1.0, Fault Reference Code table (p. 35)

codes.causes: Manual: '1. Check whether the parallel communication cables are connected well. 2. Check whether Program 23 settings are right for the parallel system.'
codes.action: Manual: '3. If problem still exists, contact repair center'
codes.source_ref: Growatt SPF 6000 ES PLUS User Manual v1.0, Trouble Shooting table (pp. 41-42)

codes.meaning: Fan is locked when inverter is on
codes.causes: Warning table: 'Fan is locked when inverter is on.' (Beep 3 times every second)
codes.action: Check the fan is free of dust/obstruction; if it stays locked, call installer.
codes.source_ref: Growatt SPF 6000 ES PLUS User Manual v1.0, Warning Indicator table (p. 36)

codes.causes: Warning table: 'Over temperature'
codes.action: Reduce load, improve ventilation; see Fault 02.
codes.source_ref: Growatt SPF 6000 ES PLUS User Manual v1.0, Warning Indicator table (p. 36)

codes.causes: Warning table: 'Battery is over-charged'
codes.action: Check battery settings with installer (see Fault 03).
codes.source_ref: Growatt SPF 6000 ES PLUS User Manual v1.0, Warning Indicator table (p. 36)

codes.causes: Warning table: 'Overload' (Beep once every 0.5 second)
codes.action: Switch off some loads.
codes.source_ref: Growatt SPF 6000 ES PLUS User Manual v1.0, Warning Indicator table (p. 36)

codes.causes: Warning table: 'Output power derating'
codes.action: Reduce load; usually from high temperature or high PV voltage. No cause text in manual.
codes.source_ref: Growatt SPF 6000 ES PLUS User Manual v1.0, Warning Indicator table (p. 36)

codes.meaning: Solar charger stops due to low battery
codes.causes: Warning table: 'Solar charger stops due to low battery'
codes.action: Recharge the battery / check battery (no further text in manual).
codes.source_ref: Growatt SPF 6000 ES PLUS User Manual v1.0, Warning Indicator table (p. 36)

codes.meaning: Solar charger stops due to high PV voltage
codes.causes: Warning table: 'Solar charger stops due to high PV voltage'
codes.action: Installer must check PV string configuration (no further text in manual).
codes.source_ref: Growatt SPF 6000 ES PLUS User Manual v1.0, Warning Indicator table (p. 36)

codes.meaning: Solar charger stops due to overload
codes.causes: Warning table: 'Solar charger stops due to overload'
codes.action: Reduce PV/charging load (no further text in manual).
codes.source_ref: Growatt SPF 6000 ES PLUS User Manual v1.0, Warning Indicator table (p. 36)

codes.causes: Warning table: 'Battery disconnect' (No beep)
codes.action: Check battery breaker/cables are connected; if unsure call installer.
codes.source_ref: Growatt SPF 6000 ES PLUS User Manual v1.0, Warning Indicator table (p. 36)

codes.causes: Warning table: 'PV power insufficient'
codes.action: Normal at low sun; no action in manual.
codes.source_ref: Growatt SPF 6000 ES PLUS User Manual v1.0, Warning Indicator table (p. 36)

codes.causes: Warning table: 'BMS communication loss'
codes.action: Check BMS cable and protocol setting (see Warning 20).
codes.source_ref: Growatt SPF 6000 ES PLUS User Manual v1.0, Warning Indicator table (p. 36)

brands.name: Huawei SUN2000 (L1 single-phase residential)
brands.models: SUN2000-2KTL-L1 to 6KTL-L1 (alarm IDs are shared across SUN2000 families per Huawei, but only the L1 manual was read)
brands.manual_note: English Issue 10 (2022-10-27) PDF copy; Huawei's official download area is solar.huawei.com (hosts other-language editions, e.g. https://solar.huawei.com/-/media/Solar/attachment/pdf/eu/service/download/SUN2000-2-6KTL-L1-UserManual-GR.pdf). Newer editions exist (Issue 20, 2024-05-30; Edition 24 ES, 2026-01-30) and were not read.

codes.meaning: PV string open-circuit voltage exceeds the inverter maximum (too many modules in series)
codes.causes: Manual: 'The PV array is not properly configured. Excessive PV modules are connected in series to the PV string, and therefore the open-circuit voltage exceeds the maximum SUN2000 operating voltage.' Cause ID 1 = PV1, 2 = PV2.
codes.action: Manual: 'Check the serial connection configuration of the PV string and ensure that the PV string open-circuit voltage is not greater than the maximum operating voltage of the SUN2000.' Installer task.
codes.source_ref: SUN2000-(2KTL-6KTL)-L1 User Manual Issue 10 (2022-10-27), 8.3 Troubleshooting, Table 8-2 Common alarms and troubleshooting measures (pp. 82-94)

codes.meaning: Electric arc on PV string cables
codes.causes: Manual: 'The PV string power cables arc or are in poor contact.'
codes.action: Manual: 'Check whether the string cables arc or are in poor contact.' Owner: do not touch DC wiring; call installer.
codes.source_ref: SUN2000-(2KTL-6KTL)-L1 User Manual Issue 10 (2022-10-27), 8.3 Troubleshooting, Table 8-2 Common alarms and troubleshooting measures (pp. 82-94)

codes.meaning: PV string connected with reversed polarity
codes.causes: Manual: 'The PV string is reversely connected.'
codes.action: Manual: 'wait until the PV string current decreases below 0.5 A, set DC switch to OFF, and adjust the PV string polarity.' Installer task.
codes.source_ref: SUN2000-(2KTL-6KTL)-L1 User Manual Issue 10 (2022-10-27), 8.3 Troubleshooting, Table 8-2 Common alarms and troubleshooting measures (pp. 82-94)

codes.causes: Manual: '1: The AFCI check circuit is abnormal. 2: The AFCI circuit is faulty.'
codes.action: Manual: 'Turn off the AC output switch and DC input switch, and then turn them on after 5 minutes. If the fault persists, contact your dealer or Huawei technical support.'
codes.source_ref: SUN2000-(2KTL-6KTL)-L1 User Manual Issue 10 (2022-10-27), 8.3 Troubleshooting, Table 8-2 Common alarms and troubleshooting measures (pp. 82-94)

codes.meaning: No grid (outage or AC breaker off)
codes.causes: Manual: 'The power grid experiences an outage. The AC circuit is disconnected or the AC circuit breaker is OFF.'
codes.action: Manual: '1. Check the AC voltage. 2. Check whether the AC circuit is disconnected or the AC circuit breaker is OFF.' Owner: check for load-shedding and the AC breaker.
codes.source_ref: SUN2000-(2KTL-6KTL)-L1 User Manual Issue 10 (2022-10-27), 8.3 Troubleshooting, Table 8-2 Common alarms and troubleshooting measures (pp. 82-94)

codes.causes: Manual: 'The grid voltage is below the lower threshold or the low voltage duration has lasted for more than the value specified by low voltage ride-through (LVRT).'
codes.action: Manual: '1. If the alarm occurs occasionally, the power grid may be abnormal temporarily. The SUN2000 automatically recovers... 2. If the alarm occurs frequently, check whether the power grid voltage is within the allowed range. If no, contact the local power operator. If yes, modify the grid undervoltage protection threshold ... with the consent of the local power operator.'
codes.source_ref: SUN2000-(2KTL-6KTL)-L1 User Manual Issue 10 (2022-10-27), 8.3 Troubleshooting, Table 8-2 Common alarms and troubleshooting measures (pp. 82-94)

codes.causes: Manual: 'The grid voltage exceeds the higher threshold or the high voltage has lasted for more than the value specified by high voltage ride-through (HVRT).'
codes.action: Manual: same as 2033 (occasional = wait; frequent = check grid voltage, contact power operator; threshold change only with operator consent); '3. Check whether the peak voltage of the power grid is too high.'
codes.source_ref: SUN2000-(2KTL-6KTL)-L1 User Manual Issue 10 (2022-10-27), 8.3 Troubleshooting, Table 8-2 Common alarms and troubleshooting measures (pp. 82-94)

codes.causes: Manual: 'Power grid exception: The actual power grid frequency is higher than the standard requirement for the local power grid.'
codes.action: Manual: occasional = auto recovers; frequent = 'check whether the power grid frequency is within the allowed range. If no, contact the local power operator.'
codes.source_ref: SUN2000-(2KTL-6KTL)-L1 User Manual Issue 10 (2022-10-27), 8.3 Troubleshooting, Table 8-2 Common alarms and troubleshooting measures (pp. 82-94)

codes.causes: Manual: 'Power grid exception: The actual power grid frequency is lower than the standard requirement for the local power grid.'
codes.action: Manual: occasional = auto recovers; frequent = check grid frequency / contact local power operator.
codes.source_ref: SUN2000-(2KTL-6KTL)-L1 User Manual Issue 10 (2022-10-27), 8.3 Troubleshooting, Table 8-2 Common alarms and troubleshooting measures (pp. 82-94)

codes.causes: Manual: 'Power grid exception: The actual grid frequency change rate does not comply with the local power grid standard.'
codes.action: Manual: occasional = auto recovers; frequent = check grid frequency / contact local power operator.
codes.source_ref: SUN2000-(2KTL-6KTL)-L1 User Manual Issue 10 (2022-10-27), 8.3 Troubleshooting, Table 8-2 Common alarms and troubleshooting measures (pp. 82-94)

codes.causes: Manual: 'The power grid voltage drops dramatically or the power grid is short-circuited. As a result, the SUN2000 transient output current exceeds the upper threshold and therefore the SUN2000 protection is triggered.'
codes.action: Manual: '1. ... After the fault is rectified, the SUN2000 automatically recovers. 2. If the alarm occurs frequently and affects the energy yield of the power plant, check whether the output is short-circuited. If the fault persists, contact your dealer or Huawei technical support.'
codes.source_ref: SUN2000-(2KTL-6KTL)-L1 User Manual Issue 10 (2022-10-27), 8.3 Troubleshooting, Table 8-2 Common alarms and troubleshooting measures (pp. 82-94)

codes.meaning: Too much DC in AC output
codes.causes: Manual: 'The DC component of the SUN2000 output current exceeds the specified upper threshold.'
codes.action: Manual: auto recovers; 'If the alarm occurs frequently, contact your dealer or Huawei technical support.'
codes.source_ref: SUN2000-(2KTL-6KTL)-L1 User Manual Issue 10 (2022-10-27), 8.3 Troubleshooting, Table 8-2 Common alarms and troubleshooting measures (pp. 82-94)

codes.causes: Manual: 'The insulation impedance of the input side to PE decreases when the SUN2000 is operating.'
codes.action: Manual: '1. If the alarm occurs occasionally, the external circuit may be abnormal temporarily. The SUN2000 automatically recovers... 2. If the alarm occurs frequently or persists, check whether the impedance between the PV string and the ground is too low.' Installer task.
codes.source_ref: SUN2000-(2KTL-6KTL)-L1 User Manual Issue 10 (2022-10-27), 8.3 Troubleshooting, Table 8-2 Common alarms and troubleshooting measures (pp. 82-94)

codes.meaning: PV array insulation to ground too low
codes.causes: Manual: 'A short circuit occurs between the PV array and the ground.' / 'The ambient air of the PV array is damp and the insulation between the PV array and the ground is poor.'
codes.action: Manual: '1. Check the output impedance of the PV array to ground... 2. Check that the PE cable of the SUN2000 is correctly connected. 3. If the impedance is lower than the specified protection threshold in rainy and cloudy days, set Insulation resistance protection using the mobile App...' Installer task; often appears after rain.

codes.source_ref: Voltronic Axpert VM III User Manual v1.8, 'TROUBLE SHOOTING' table (p. 43)

codes.causes: Fault table: 'Battery voltage is too low'. Troubleshooting (startup shutdown): 'The battery voltage is too low (<1.91V/Cell)'
codes.action: Manual: '1. Re-charge battery. 2. Replace battery.'
codes.source_ref: Voltronic Axpert VM III User Manual v1.8, 'TROUBLE SHOOTING' table (p. 43)

codes.causes: Manual: 'Output short circuited or over temperature is detected by internal converter components.'
codes.action: Manual: 'Check if wiring is connected well and remove abnormal load.'
codes.source_ref: Voltronic Axpert VM III User Manual v1.8, 'TROUBLE SHOOTING' table (p. 43)

codes.meaning: Output voltage too high / too low
codes.causes: Manual: 'Output abnormal (Inverter voltage below than 190Vac or is higher than 260Vac)'
codes.action: Manual: '1. Reduce the connected load. 2. Return to repair center'
codes.source_ref: Voltronic Axpert VM III User Manual v1.8, 'TROUBLE SHOOTING' table (p. 43)

codes.causes: Manual: 'Overload error. The inverter is overload 110% and time is up.' Also: 'If PV input voltage is higher than specification, the output power will be derated... it will cause overload.'
codes.action: Manual: 'Reduce the connected load by switching off some equipment.' / 'Reduce the number of PV modules in series or the connected load.'
codes.source_ref: Voltronic Axpert VM III User Manual v1.8, 'TROUBLE SHOOTING' table (p. 43)

codes.meaning: Bus voltage too high / bus soft start failed / inverter soft start failed / current sensor failed
codes.causes: Manual: 'Internal components failed.'
codes.action: Manual: 'Return to repair center.'
codes.source_ref: Voltronic Axpert VM III User Manual v1.8, 'TROUBLE SHOOTING' table (p. 43)

codes.causes: Manual: 'Over current or surge.'
codes.action: Manual: 'Restart the unit, if the error happens again, please return to repair center.'
codes.source_ref: Voltronic Axpert VM III User Manual v1.8, 'TROUBLE SHOOTING' table (p. 43)

codes.causes: Manual: 'Bus voltage is too low.'
codes.action: Manual: 'Restart the unit, if the error happens again, please return to repair center.'
codes.source_ref: Voltronic Axpert VM III User Manual v1.8, 'TROUBLE SHOOTING' table (p. 43)

codes.meaning: Over DC voltage in AC output / output voltage unbalanced
codes.causes: Manual: 'Output voltage is unbalanced.'
codes.action: Manual: 'Restart the unit, if the error happens again, please return to repair center.'
codes.source_ref: Voltronic Axpert VM III User Manual v1.8, 'TROUBLE SHOOTING' table (p. 43)

codes.causes: Manual: 'PV input voltage is beyond the specification.'
codes.action: Manual: 'Reduce the number of PV modules in series.' Installer task.
codes.source_ref: Voltronic Axpert VM III User Manual v1.8, 'TROUBLE SHOOTING' table (p. 43)

codes.meaning: Fan is locked when inverter is on (beep three times every second)
codes.causes: Warning table entry.
codes.action: Check fan is free; if it persists call installer.
codes.source_ref: Voltronic Axpert VM III 1.5KW/3KW/5KW User Manual v1.8, 'Fault Reference Code' and 'Warning Indicator' tables (p. 39)

codes.causes: Warning table entry.
codes.action: Reduce load, improve ventilation.
codes.source_ref: Voltronic Axpert VM III 1.5KW/3KW/5KW User Manual v1.8, 'Fault Reference Code' and 'Warning Indicator' tables (p. 39)

codes.meaning: Battery is over-charged (beep once every second)
codes.causes: Warning table entry.
codes.action: Check charger/battery settings with installer.
codes.source_ref: Voltronic Axpert VM III 1.5KW/3KW/5KW User Manual v1.8, 'Fault Reference Code' and 'Warning Indicator' tables (p. 39)

codes.causes: Warning table entry.
codes.action: Recharge battery; reduce load.
codes.source_ref: Voltronic Axpert VM III 1.5KW/3KW/5KW User Manual v1.8, 'Fault Reference Code' and 'Warning Indicator' tables (p. 39)

codes.causes: Warning table entry.
codes.action: Switch off some loads.
codes.source_ref: Voltronic Axpert VM III 1.5KW/3KW/5KW User Manual v1.8, 'Fault Reference Code' and 'Warning Indicator' tables (p. 39)

codes.meaning: Output power derating (beep twice every 3 seconds)
codes.causes: Warning table entry.
codes.action: Reduce load; see Fault 07 note on high PV voltage derating.
codes.source_ref: Voltronic Axpert VM III 1.5KW/3KW/5KW User Manual v1.8, 'Fault Reference Code' and 'Warning Indicator' tables (p. 39)

codes.meaning: PV energy is low (beep twice every 3 seconds)
codes.causes: Warning table entry.
codes.action: Normal in low sun; no action in manual.
codes.source_ref: Voltronic Axpert VM III 1.5KW/3KW/5KW User Manual v1.8, 'Fault Reference Code' and 'Warning Indicator' tables (p. 39)

codes.meaning: High AC input (>280VAC) during BUS soft start
codes.causes: Warning table entry.
codes.action: Wait for utility voltage to normalise; if frequent, have installer check input voltage.
codes.source_ref: Voltronic Axpert VM III 1.5KW/3KW/5KW User Manual v1.8, 'Fault Reference Code' and 'Warning Indicator' tables (p. 39)

codes.meaning: Communication failure between inverter and remote display panel
codes.causes: Warning table entry.
codes.action: Check the display panel cable; installer if persistent.
codes.source_ref: Voltronic Axpert VM III 1.5KW/3KW/5KW User Manual v1.8, 'Fault Reference Code' and 'Warning Indicator' tables (p. 39)

codes.meaning: Battery is not connected / Battery equalization
codes.causes: Warning table entries (no number; icon only). Troubleshooting: 'Battery is disconnected.' -> relay switches on and off repeatedly
codes.action: Manual: 'Check if battery wires are connected well.'
codes.source_ref: Voltronic Axpert VM III 1.5KW/3KW/5KW User Manual v1.8, 'Fault Reference Code' and 'Warning Indicator' tables (p. 39)
